authority.alpha_prerequisite: Complete the remaining C-06 physical-policy decision with a configurable exact-byte scan-resistant rrflowKV page cache and a real persisted mixed-family differential, while preserving one persistence authority below future stamped rrflowQL/DataFusion execution.

current_behavior: The clean baseline has one RRFlow-owned exact-byte immutable page cache shared by database segments, but it admits every fitting miss into one LRU region. A broad projected scan can evict repeatedly used graph, lexical, vector, and control pages. The physical-policy laboratory advances a two-region cache only in simulation; production policy is not configurable, duplicate losing loads are unclassified, and no real same-corpus exact-versus-scan-resistant mixed-family evidence exists.
target_behavior: Add a closed PageCachePolicy with selectable ExactLru and default ScanResistantLru modes. Preserve exact-byte charging and immutable Arc ownership; admit new pages probationary, promote on cache reuse, demote protected LRU pages above a validated target, evict probationary first, and count admissions, rejections, promotions, demotions, and duplicate loads. Prove byte-identical reads, strict capacity, reopen invariance, and fewer post-scan hot loads on one real persisted eight-family corpus. Keep the cache below RrdEngine and the future rrflowQL/DataFusion TableProvider, and close C-06 only if all canonical evidence is satisfied.
unchanged_behavior: WAL, MVCC, manifest-v3, segment-v6 encoding, snapshot-bundle-v1, adaptive LZ4, row-group filters, projected-read ordering, tombstones, compaction publication, garbage collection, and RrdEngine transaction authority remain unchanged.
The cache remains process-local and non-durable; replacement policy never enters segment, manifest, WAL, snapshot, application-key, query, or public transport encodings.
rrflowQL/DataFusion remains downstream stamped compute over bounded Arrow-compatible batches and cannot own persistence, authorization, page admission, or direct writes.
No family-specific capacity, caller-selected cache bypass, Moka, TinyLFU, ghost cache, value log, cache daemon, alternate storage engine, hook, routine, skill, adapter, or provider state is added.

Lock sharding, in-flight load coalescing, pinned-owner concurrency, cancellation fairness, and sustained stress remain C-07 work; this package records duplicate loads without claiming to prevent them.

Product version remains 1.0.0; installation, attunement, native graph/BM25/vector/TurboQuant, SDK/API/MCP/Connectome, distribution, and release work remain separately gated; only rrflow/rrflow-development may receive this package.

first_failure_oracle: The new public page-cache test is added before production edits and must initially fail to compile because PageCachePolicy and its new evidence fields are absent.
Invalid protected ratios must fail before the database directory exists; reopening the same durable bytes with either valid policy must preserve manifest, snapshot, ordering, and values.

The real eight-family corpus must exceed cache capacity, force at least one exact-LRU post-scan reload, and permit a reused hot set to remain protected; otherwise the workload is vacuous and the plan stops.
Exact and scan-resistant policies must produce independently expected byte-identical projected rows and hot values while remaining within exact capacity; any semantic or bound difference fails.
An oversize page is served but rejected from admission, stale heap entries cannot select the wrong victim, and a promoted Arc retains identity through demotion and eviction pressure.

stop_conditions: A required implementation, test, documentation, generator, or evidence path is missing from this machine plan.
Exact and scan-resistant policies return different rows, values, ordering, snapshot identity, or durable bytes.
Total residency exceeds capacity, scan-resistant region totals disagree, I/O occurs under the mutex, or eviction invalidates an active reader Arc.
A caller, semantic family, DataFusion node, provider, hook, routine, skill, or external service gains physical cache authority.
Moka, TinyLFU, a ghost cache, another cache crate, value separation, a second persistence engine, or a durable compatibility path appears necessary.
The real workload is vacuous, exact LRU does not reload after the scan, or scan resistance does not strictly reduce post-scan loads.
Duplicate-load evidence is presented as coalescing, or C-07 concurrency and scalability are claimed without its stress proof.
A benchmark or one-host artifact is described as release, scale, latency, network, or competitor superiority evidence.
C-06 is closed from compilation, simulation, or this metric alone rather than every named canonical prerequisite.
